## Summary and scope

<!-- State the source branch/head, base branch and one bounded change. Link related issue/stacked PR. -->

## Evidence and acceptance

- [ ] Source/build/unit/CI outcome recorded, or N/A with reason
- [ ] If PC/GTA work: named operator, P2/controller path and approved runtime identity recorded, or NOT RUN
- [ ] Command completion distinguished from **gameplay/world** acceptance; no unsupported PASS claims
- [ ] Failed/unknown outcomes, missing data and known limitations preserved (no silent retries)
- [ ] If game files touched: GTA stopped and hash/absence rollback evidenced, or N/A
- [ ] Any PR title/description that this result supersedes was updated or explicitly linked

## Agent/operator readiness

- [ ] Read `AGENTS.md` and [operating standard](../docs/agent-operations/OPERATING-STANDARD.md); read [GTA/PC playbook](../docs/agent-operations/GTA-PC-PLAYBOOK.md) if applicable
- [ ] Confirm latest head/base and dependency chain (older experimental branches may lack current policy)
- [ ] Use read-only CLI/API/native controls before GUI; **no** unsolicited Afterburner preset clicks or graphics-menu browsing
- [ ] State exact next authorized action, ownership, safe stop conditions and unresolved work

<!-- These prompts help humans and agents; a checkbox is not a security or compliance proof. -->
